Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
输入是bf16的场景部分case出现精度问题
### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
A2服务器
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
RDV aclnn冒烟发现
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
期望精度一切OK
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
执行环境：80.48.5.175 root/DCauto12#$
执行路径：/npu/xrun/TuringAclnn2/op/aclnn_fuzz
今天冒烟包：source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
B060包: source /home/l60072764/version/B060/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
执行命令：
1.source CANN包路径
2.python3 xrunfk.py bm aclnnConvolutionBackward aclnnConvolutionBackward_Conv3DBackpropInputV2_bfloat16_NCDHW_groups_depthwise_tilingKey_ID_0010.cs
3.python3 xrunfk.py npu_off aclnnConvolutionBackward aclnnConvolutionBackward_Conv3DBackpropInputV2_bfloat16_NCDHW_groups_depthwise_tilingKey_ID_0010.cs
后面跟的是casename,可以看表格来跑哪些是错的跑，
### Special notes for this issue/备注 (Optional / 选填)
